additional_info.subject: RE: ID0473474-DC/Si-D/HG-[MP / S4 170003364] RFID related Queries CRM:02888000557
additional_info.body:
Hello,
The customer asked more questions, can you answer these too? (I highlighted them below)
Before using the cards, the customer was asked to peform hardening, which consists of the following steps:
- Usage of AES128 encryption on the cards
- Mutual authentication must be configured
- Secure messaging must be enabled
- Every card must use unique (and not the default) keys
Second question: Have you ever been asked to perform such hardening on Sicharge D card readers (or any other hardening)?
There is also a more general question they would like to ask, as not only their own RFID cards are used at their charging stations, but also other drivers from other e-mobility providers can charge their vehicles at their stations using the RFID cards issued by their providers.
Third question: the question is, if they implement such hardening, will their RFID cards used by other providers (which they don't know exactly what type they are, etc.) work on their readers?
Thank you!
Kind regards,
Laszlo
Yours sincerely,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0473474-DC/Si-D/HG-[MP / S4 170003364] RFID related Queries CRM:02888000557
additional_info.body:
Hello,
This isn’t just about testing a specific type of RFID card.
The customer is also asking more generally what Siemens’ position is regarding RFID hardening.
Before using the cards, the customer was asked to peform hardening, which consists of the following steps:
- Usage of AES128 encryption on the cards
- Mutual authentication must be configured
- Secure messaging must be enabled
- Every card must use unique (and not the default) keys
Second question: Have you ever been asked to perform such hardening on Sicharge D card readers (or any other hardening)?
There is also a more general question they would like to ask, as not only their own RFID cards are used at their charging stations, but also other drivers from other e-mobility providers can charge their vehicles at their stations using the RFID cards issued by their providers.
Third question: the question is, if they implement such hardening, will their RFID cards used by other providers (which they don't know exactly what type they are, etc.) work on their readers?
Please, answer these two questions too.
Thank you!
Kind regards,
Laszlo
After my discussion with Francisco, I think the RC did not like the way I replied. Therefore, Francisco asked me to send this ticket to L3.
